name: Cala Porta Vecchia
notes: The effortless city swim beneath Monopoli's old walls—best before breakfast or near sunset.

name: Porto Bianco
notes: A small, friendly cove close to town with a gentle entry and bright turquoise water.

name: Cala Paradiso
notes: A photogenic pocket cove with both free areas and lido services in summer.

name: Porto Rosso
notes: Easy to combine with Porto Bianco on a relaxed coastal walk from the center.

name: Punta della Suina
notes: The trip's priority beach: fragrant pines, rocky islets and luminous Ionian water.

name: Porto Selvaggio
notes: A nature reserve north of Gallipoli. The walk is part of the pleasure; wear sturdy sandals.

name: Baia Verde
notes: The easiest classic sandy beach from Gallipoli, with plenty of lidos and free stretches.

name: Punta Pizzo
notes: A protected, quieter-feeling landscape south of town; confirm seasonal transport first.

name: Spiaggia della Purità
notes: Compact and convenient beneath the old town—perfect for arrival day or a quick last dip.

name: Baia dei Turchi
notes: A must-swim series of pale coves reached through protected Mediterranean woodland.

name: Alimini Beaches
notes: Longer and more spacious than Baia dei Turchi, with easy lido facilities and open water.

name: Baia dell'Orte
notes: Wild, unserviced and rewarding for confident swimmers; bring everything you need.

name: Torre Sant'Andrea
notes: Dramatic sea stacks and dazzling water. Better for scenic swimming than beach lounging.
